summary: Compose host-owned Landing profiles, linked-child publication, native member verification and exact retired proof receipts

replay.detail: Fractal.start journals committed linked-child publication and returns the same ChildHandle after a lost acknowledgement or restart. Existing Fractal.run behavior, durable operation keys and replay remain unchanged. Resolved host profile estimates stay frozen through restart.

schema.detail: The program API adds ChildHandle {run}, ChildConflict {run, reason}, Fractal.start(mission, input, {id, runId, reportTo?}) and Fractal.await(handle). Optional reportTo accepts an exact agent/... subject without normalization, matching CLI missions start --report-to; there is no reportCompleted start option. Direct DSL/program roots extend existing resource.exec-receipt emission with the frozen payload argv binding, exact owner step/attempt and runtime generation; exact receipt reads return the authoritative reference and bound fields.

rules.detail: Start returns only after durable child publication is committed and visible. runId follows mission-run declaration ID rules; id remains the journal key. Conflicting creation identity, parent, input or explicit reportTo is a typed ChildConflict, never silent adoption or reparenting. reportTo replaces the mission reporting destination for failure, cancellation and stall reports, does not imply --report-completed, and preserves mission stalled-after (default 30 minutes); omission retains the mission reporting default. Parent cancellation and initiating-principal inheritance remain linked. reportTo is routing only: it never sets initiating_principal or authorizes Landing. Host profiles and Landing use one resolver and existing memory/IO totals; unauthorized Landing is refused without class downgrade.

compatibility.detail: Existing run IDs and shell receipt semantics are not reinterpreted. Direct proof receipts require confirmed whole-tree retirement, immutable payload snapshots and truthful outcomes; historical launches without snapshots remain ineligible. Member-scope now resolves direct DSL/program roots from existing custody with unchanged response shape and owner authentication. Canonical payload markers are locators, not credentials or proof of the querying process's ancestry. Nested shell submission under a direct native parent remains unsupported. CommandResult needs no exec-ID field.

downtime.detail: No automatic restart or host activation.

manual.detail: Dispatchers may hold existing reviewed-slot and per-change locks until Fractal.start returns, then release them and await outside the locks. Finalizers must receive the proof's step-run ID and attempt, select an exact runtime generation when needed, and verify retirement, host, command digest, head/clean observations, class/profile and exit rather than use their own step identity.

recovery.detail: Existing linked-child ownership, native resource custody and confirmed-retirement accounting remain authoritative. Missing or ambiguous proof evidence fails closed without fabricating launch outcomes or measured peaks.
